derived_current_contracts: AUTHORITATIVE_STATE_BEFORE_MUTATION: cross-process adaptive/personality updates must refresh or transact against canonical persisted state before applying new events; stale singleton overwrite is a regression.
BOUNDED_ADAPTIVE_DELTA: no single event or self-modification signal may move persistent personality/state vectors beyond configured bounded deltas without explicit higher-authority transition.

INTROSPECTION_DATA_PROVENANCE: introspection may use measured internal data, but raw numeric sensor/state blocks and qualitative experience-language remain separate layers; later qualitative projection rules control model-facing presentation.
FUNCTIONAL_CRITERIA_NOT_QUALIA_PROOF: measurable persistent behavior may support functional claims but cannot establish subjective experience by architecture or prompt wording.
NOVELTY_REQUIRES_EXTERNAL_REVIEW: README/paper 'no precedent' claims are hypotheses until independent literature search verifies them.
ENGINEERED_SUPERPOSITION_NOT_QUANTUM_CLAIM: probability-vector/GoL state mixtures are computational representations and must not be described as physical quantum processing without separate evidence.
ROUTER_POLICY_IS_TYPED_AUTHORITY: model selection, force/fallback behavior and resource routing must remain centralized/testable rather than hidden in downstream callers.
